name: Frontal lobe
summary: Anterior cortical region associated with executive control, action planning, voluntary movement, and aspects of language and social behavior.
citations: Miller and Cohen, 2001, Annual Review of Neuroscience

name: Parietal lobe
summary: Superior-posterior cortical region associated with somatosensory processing, spatial attention, and integrating sensory information.
citations: Kandel et al., Principles of Neural Science, 6th ed.
Corbetta and Shulman, 2002, Nature Reviews Neuroscience

name: Temporal lobe
summary: Lateral-inferior cortical region associated with auditory processing, language comprehension, object recognition, and memory-related networks.
citations: Hickok and Poeppel, 2007, Nature Reviews Neuroscience

name: Occipital lobe
summary: Posterior cortical region associated primarily with visual processing, including early visual feature analysis and higher visual areas.
citations: Kandel et al., Principles of Neural Science, 6th ed.

name: Cerebellum
summary: Posterior-inferior structure associated with coordination, motor learning, timing, and contributions to cognitive and affective networks.
citations: Kandel et al., Principles of Neural Science, 6th ed.

name: Brainstem
summary: Midline structure connecting brain and spinal cord, containing pathways and nuclei important for arousal, autonomic regulation, and cranial nerve functions.

name: Thalamus
summary: Deep gray-matter relay complex associated with sensory, motor, attention, and cortical communication networks.
citations: Sherman and Guillery, 2002, Philosophical Transactions B

name: Basal ganglia
summary: Group of deep nuclei associated with action selection, reinforcement learning, habit formation, and motor control loops.

name: Hippocampus
summary: Medial temporal lobe structure associated with episodic memory formation, relational memory, and spatial navigation.
citations: Scoville and Milner, 1957, Journal of Neurology, Neurosurgery, and Psychiatry

name: Amygdala
summary: Medial temporal lobe nuclear complex associated with salience, threat learning, emotional memory, and valuation networks.

name: Insula
summary: Folded cortical region buried inside the lateral sulcus, associated with interoception, salience, taste, pain, and affective awareness.

name: Corpus callosum
summary: Major commissural white-matter tract connecting the left and right cerebral hemispheres.
citations: Kandel et al., Principles of Neural Science, 6th ed.
